description: Sentence Arrangement question bank for FDA/SDA General English, derived from exam-oriented notes. Covers sentence ordering, paragraph ordering, connectors, pronoun reference, chronological order, cause-and-effect, general-to-specific order, articles, repeated keywords, opening/closing clues, problem-solution, compare-contrast, narrative structure, common mistakes, and solving methods. Verify before formal examination use.

questions.subject: English
questions.question:
Arrange the following sentences in the most logical order:
A. He works in a bank.
B. Ramesh is a hardworking young man.
C. He supports his family.
D. He goes to work every morning.
questions.explanation: B introduces Ramesh; the remaining sentences give details. Order: B-A-D-C.
